dict.string: HivemindOS uses the microphone so you can talk with your local agents during voice calls.
HivemindOS transcribes your voice on this Mac so voice chat works without sending audio to third-party services.
HivemindOS lets your paired phone browse and work with files in your Downloads folder.
HivemindOS lets your paired phone browse and work with files on your Desktop.
HivemindOS lets your paired phone browse and work with files in your Documents folder.
